title: marsdawn --json: failure
description: Printed on stdout as one line when a command run with --json fails: with exit code 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 or 7, or with exit code 64 for the usage errors that have a kind (an out-of-range --wait, skill --install's refusals, theme preview's refused -o). Other usage errors (exit code 64) are printed as text on stderr instead. marsdawn 0.7.1 and later; error.v3.json, for the same releases, leaves out the exit-64 kinds. error.v2.json is for 0.5.2–0.7.0, error.v1.json for 0.5.1 and earlier.
